where.if: AND (p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND p.poem_id IN ( SELECT pg.poem_id FROM poem_genre pg JOIN genre g ON g.genre_id = pg.genre_id WHERE g.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{genre}, '%') )

mapper.select:
SELECT p.poem_id, p.title, pt.name AS poet_name, p.create_year, p.form, p.word_count, IFNULL((SELECT ROUND(AVG(r.score), 1) FROM rating r WHERE r.poem_id = p.poem_id), 0) AS avg_score, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rating r WHERE r.poem_id = p.poem_id) AS rating_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `comment` c WHERE c.poem_id = p.poem_id) AS comment_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM favorite f WHERE f.poem_id = p.poem_id) AS favorite_count FROM poem p JOIN poet pt ON pt.poet_id = p.poet_id
ORDER BY avg_score DESC, p.poem_id DESC
ORDER BY p.title ASC
ORDER BY p.poem_id DESC
LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM poem p JOIN poet pt ON pt.poet_id = p.poet_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO poem (title, content, create_year, form, appreciation, poet_id) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{createYear}, #{form}, #{appreciation}, #{poetId})
mapper.update: UPDATE poem SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, create_year = #{createYear}, form = #{form}, appreciation = #{appreciation}, poet_id = #{poetId} WHERE poem_id = #{poemId}
